description:
Welcome to Shia Skin Care's Affiliate Program!

Brand Introduction:
At Shia Skin Care we are more than just a company; we're a community dedicated to enhancing wellness through natural skincare. Our journey began in 2016 with a vision to provide effective natural skincare, and since then, we've been committed to delivering excellence and innovation in every product we offer.

Product Description:
Our range includes luxuriously crafted skincare essentials, from rejuvenating serums to nourishing creams and Reuseable clay masks! Designed for the lazy girl/guy who wants to take care of their skin without all the extra steps! Each product is a blend of nature and science, created with the finest clays, herbal powders, oils and pure essential oils to ensure the best for your skin and well-being.

USP (Unique Selling Point):
What sets Shia Skin Care apart is our commitment to Fragrance Free products and sourcing only the finest organic ingredients.  Our innovative formulas delivers visible results. Our products are not just about beauty; they're about providing a holistic experience that promotes lasting health, confidence, and well being. Our Certified Aromatherapist creates beautifully crafted blends that give each and every product it's unique scent and effective therapeutic benefits for your skin.

Payment Terms:
Joining our affiliate program is not just joining a campaign, but becoming part of a team that values your contribution and ensures you're rewarded for it. We offer:

  • A competitive commission rate of 10% on every sale you make.
  • Payments made monthly via Paypal or Venmo
  • A minimum payout threshold of $50 ensuring you get your earnings promptly and securely.

Other Information:
As an affiliate, you'll get exclusive access to our promotional materials, including  any banners, product images, or content samples. You'll also have a dedicated affiliate manager to assist you with any queries and help you maximize your earnings.

Ready to Join?
Becoming an affiliate with Shia Skin Care means becoming a champion for truly natural beauty, sustainable living, and effective skincare products. If you share our passion and are ready to turn your influence into a rewarding experience, we'd love to have you on board. Apply now and start your journey with us today!

Sign Up Now!
